summary.text: Don Harmon, a Democrat, represents the 39th District in the Illinois Senate and has been the Senate's President since January 2020, when he was first elected to the post by his Senate colleagues.

paragraphs.text: According to his office biography, Harmon is an Oak Park native who was first elected to the Illinois Senate in 2002, and previously served as president pro tempore.

The biography says he has an undergraduate degree in English and economics from Knox College and a law degree and MBA from the University of Chicago, and that he left a position at the law firm Burke Burns & Pinelli to focus on the Senate presidency.
